critical_issues: Lookahead feature in model: 'opt_vol_pct_cumday' — Divides running cumulative volume by total-day volume (opt_vol.sum()), which is only known after market close. At bar T this denominator includes all future bars on the day.

random_data_test.explanation: Model generated only 0 high-confidence signal(s) on 1000 random samples (threshold ≤5). Model is uncertain on noise — consistent with no leakage.

suspicious_patterns.description: Total day volume (opt_vol.sum()) is used to normalise the per-bar cumulative volume feature. At bar T, total day volume includes all future bars — unavailable in live trading.
suspicious_patterns.recommendation: Replace with a rolling or fixed estimate of daily volume, or drop opt_vol_pct_cumday from the feature set.
